name: House Storm
summary: Northern iron, timber, and professional soldiers. They say they are older than Nezrel.

name: House Maren
summary: Horses, wheat, and a careful neutrality. They raised Arlo and never explained the royal payments.

name: House Veyne
summary: Ships, ports, and the patience of people who can starve a kingdom without drawing a sword.

name: House Harrow
summary: An old western house with more pride than coin. They will back almost anyone who keeps Storm off the throne.

name: House Edevane
summary: Mira's birth house. Their wealth is the marriage. If she falls, they expect to fall with her, unless Edric has already moved.
